name: projipsa
description: A project butler that keeps source-backed operational memory current for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: A project butler for durable project memory.
interface.longDescription: Projipsa acts as a project butler: it initializes source-backed project memory, prepares the right context, keeps current state and decisions tidy, preserves evidence, and makes paused work easy to resume.
defaultPrompt: Use $projipsa to update this project's memory after the work.
Use $projipsa-init to onboard this existing project.
